summary: Re-tested ONLY the /browse Extra Filters language-pill badge count fix. All 5 RE-TEST cases PASS. activeExtraCount now correctly sums scalar-key count + filters.languages.length, so each language pill increments the badge by 1. The fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Browse.js (line 60-61) `EXTRA_FILTER_KEYS.filter(isActive).length + (filters.languages?.length || 0)` works as specified.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings about <span> child of <option>/<select> still emitted by the visual-edit tracking wrapper (cosmetic, not blocking; reported in iteration_2 as well).

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct. Consider hardening: replace `(filters.languages?.length || 0)` with an isArray guard if `languages` is ever assigned a non-array, but current state initializer `languages: []` keeps this safe.
ALL_EXTRA_KEYS dead code from iteration_2 has been removed — confirmed via grep. Good cleanup.
Future multi-select filters (e.g., services[]) should follow the same pattern — extract a helper `countActive(filters)` to avoid re-introducing the under-counting bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fully resolved. Verified live on /browse?v=6 with city='Paris' + Female pill set: French→1, +German→2, +Brunette→3, +English→4, Clear all filters→badge gone, city='Paris' preserved, Female pill class unchanged. Test selectors used: filters-button (opens panel), extra-lang-{french|german|english} (pills), extra-hair_color (HTML <select>, use select_option(value='Brunette')), extra-filters-clear (clear button — note: the clear button data-testid is 'extra-filters-clear' on the panel itself, not 'clear-extra-filters').
rca of the issue: Iteration_2 RCA correctly identified that Array.isArray-as-boolean only contributed +1. The applied fix splits the count: scalar EXTRA_FILTER_KEYS via filter(isActive).length plus filters.languages.length. Verified end-to-end: each subsequent language pill now adds exactly 1 to the badge, and Clear All resets everything except city/gender (which live outside the extra-filter state slice).
